话我知: waa6 ngo5 zi1 - speak to me know, teach me (tell me)
先至: sin1 zi3 - until now, can imply "too late"
你知道唔知道: nei5 zi1 dou6 m4 zi1 dou6 - do you know? (or not)
我啱啱先至知道呢个: ngo5 ngaam1 ngaam1 sin1 zi3 zi1 dou6 ni1 go3 - I didn't know this until just now
你先至嚟?: nei5 sin1 zi3 leng - you only now came?
你而家先至话我知: nei5 ji gaa sin1 zi3 waa6 ngo5 zi1 - you only now tell me??
你贵姓呀: nei5 gwai3 sing3 aa1 - what is your (lovely) name?
贵唔贵: gwai3 m4 gwai3 - expensive or not?
小姐: siu2 ze2 - lady / Ms (generally before marriage), "small sister"
位: wai2 - measure word (replacing go3), more respectful
佢叫咩名呀: keoi5 giu3 me1 meng2 aa1 - what is his name?
福倒: fuk dou (inverted) - luck arrived — 倒 (upside down) sounds like 到
祝你有福: zuk1 nei5 jau5 fuk1 - wish you have luck
